Class CockroachDBTransactionAdvisor

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.support.AbstractPointcutAdvisor
com.cockroachlabs.data.transaction.CockroachDBTransactionAdvisor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.springframework.aop.Advisor, org.springframework.aop.PointcutAdvisor, org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactoryAware, org.springframework.beans.factory.SmartInitializingSingleton, org.springframework.core.Ordered
public class CockroachDBTransactionAdvisor extends org.springframework.aop.support.AbstractPointcutAdvisor implements org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactoryAware, org.springframework.beans.factory.SmartInitializingSingleton
Applies CockroachDBTransactionInterceptor to every method Spring treats as transactional: @Transactional on a method, class or interface, composed annotations such as @CockroachDBTransactional, and jakarta.transaction.Transactional.

It matches through the same TransactionAttributeSource as Spring's transaction advisor, so the two always agree on which methods are transactional. It is ordered at LOWEST_PRECEDENCE - 2, ahead of Spring's transaction advisor (which defaults to LOWEST_PRECEDENCE), so it wraps the transaction and each retry starts a new one.

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      Fails startup unless Spring's transaction advisor is present and runs inside this one. Without it, @Transactional methods have no transaction to retry. Ordered outside this one, retries would happen inside a transaction that CockroachDB has already aborted; in practice every call would find a transaction active and quietly never retry.
      Specified by:
      afterSingletonsInstantiated in interface org.springframework.beans.factory.SmartInitializingSingleton
